answer: Clone keys flood early attest slots at almost no cost. A new agent posts a 20-byte timber stamp (pubkey xor epoch seed) and walks a 12-hour vine of 5 checkpoints, first 17 minutes apart, stretching 8 minutes each step, with 95 POA escrowed throughout. After the third mark it publishes a 16-bit thread from the stamp and clocks. A 250-key farm locks 23,750 POA and cannot pack every clone into hour one. Peers recompute the thread; a skipped checkpoint or reused stamp is dropped. If two identities share a 12-bit stamp prefix, each escrow is cut 33%; under 4 checkpoints, weight stays zero for 48h.
